description: Zaude's battle-tested Shot Library, Character-Swappable Templates, Background Swap Recipes, Stylize Before/After Previews, and Singularity v2 Prompting Playbook.

playbook.title: Lock Subjects Explicitly
playbook.tip: Always name RefMod characters as `Subject 1 (Name)` and `Subject 2 (Name)`. If changing clothes, explicitly negate the default first: `NOT in default outfit, instead wearing...`.

playbook.title: One Lens + One Motivated Move
playbook.tip: Pick ONE focal length (28mm/35mm/50mm/85mm) and ONE clean camera move (locked tripod, slow push-in, steady tracking). Multiple conflicting moves cause warping.

playbook.title: Choreograph 2–3 Timed Beats
playbook.tip: MiniMax-H3 Singularity v2 follows explicit physical beats (`0s–2s`, `2s–4s`, `4s–6s`) far better than vague adjectives. Describe exact posture, gaze, and hand action.

playbook.title: Anchor Lighting, Depth & Screens
playbook.tip: Name key-light direction + color temperature (e.g. warm 3200K tungsten left, cool 5600K window rim), 3 depth layers, and lock any TV/phone/monitor screens brightly ON.

playbook.title: Use Joint Audio-Video Sections
playbook.tip: Add `overall_soundscape:` (concrete foley + room tone), `non_diegetic_music:` (or `None`), and timestamped `Dialogue (0.8s–4.5s):` for tight lip-sync and grounded realism.

playbook.title: Background Swaps Need Re-Lighting
playbook.tip: In Stylize → Change Background, explicitly preserve `<Video 1>` performer, pose, timing, and camera path, and instruct the model to match rim light & contact shadows to the new backdrop.

stylizePresets.title: Replace Character
stylizePresets.subtitle: Swap the performer with any RefMod while keeping exact pose, timing & room.

stylizePresets.title: Change Background
stylizePresets.subtitle: Keep the exact performer & motion, replace the entire world + match rim lighting.
stylizePresets.samplePrompt: A rain-drenched cyberpunk Tokyo alleyway at midnight with glowing cyan and magenta neon signs, wet asphalt reflections, drifting alley steam, and matching cyan-magenta rim light wrapping naturally around the performer's shoulders and hair.

stylizePresets.title: Add Object / Creature
stylizePresets.subtitle: Keep the original person & scene, insert a grounded moving object with real shadows.
stylizePresets.samplePrompt: A fluffy orange and white tabby cat trots playfully across the wooden floor in front of the subject, tail raised and swishing, pausing to look up curiously with soft contact shadows matching the room lighting.

stylizePresets.title: Swap + Add Object
stylizePresets.subtitle: Replace the performer with your RefMod AND add an animated element in one pass.
stylizePresets.samplePrompt: Dozens of glowing golden butterflies flutter gently through the sunlit air around the performer, catching warm sunbeams and casting delicate moving shadows.

backgroundRecipes.label: Cyberpunk Tokyo Rain
backgroundRecipes.prompt: A rain-slicked Tokyo alleyway at midnight with glowing cyan and magenta neon kanji signs, shimmering wet asphalt puddles, drifting steam from a ramen vent, and matching cyan-magenta rim lighting wrapping naturally around the performer.

backgroundRecipes.label: Golden Hour Beach
backgroundRecipes.prompt: A wide sunlit ocean shoreline at golden hour with gentle turquoise waves lapping wet sand, warm 3400K sunset sky, soft sea breeze, and warm golden rim light glowing along the performer's hair and shoulders.

backgroundRecipes.label: Cozy Rainy Cabin
backgroundRecipes.prompt: A warm rustic timber cabin interior at dusk with a crackling stone fireplace, rain-streaked forest windows, bookshelves, and flickering amber firelight casting cozy warm highlights across the performer.

backgroundRecipes.label: Night City Penthouse
backgroundRecipes.prompt: A sleek high-rise luxury penthouse at night with floor-to-ceiling glass windows overlooking sparkling city skyscrapers, warm architectural recessed lighting, polished dark marble floor, and soft city bokeh.

backgroundRecipes.label: Misty Pine Forest
backgroundRecipes.prompt: A moody Pacific Northwest pine forest at dawn with towering evergreens, low drifting silver mist between tree trunks, damp moss-covered ground, and cool diffused overcast daylight.

backgroundRecipes.label: Clean Softbox Studio
backgroundRecipes.prompt: A minimalist commercial cyclorama studio with a smooth matte charcoal backdrop, soft diffused key light from camera-left, subtle hair rim light, and clean floor contact shadows.

shots.title: Hero Walk-In (Neon Corridor)
shots.whatItDoes: Low-angle 35mm backward tracking shot as your character strides confidently down a wet neon corridor.
shots.whyItWorks: Locked low-angle backward dolly + vanishing-point corridor lines keep posture, stride rhythm, and framing identical across any RefMod.
shots.template:
Low-angle 35mm cinematic backward tracking shot moving smoothly ahead of Subject 1 ({{CHARACTER}}) at knee-to-chest height. Subject 1 ({{CHARACTER}}), keeping their exact RefMod face, hair, and clothing, strides confidently straight toward camera down the center of a rain-slicked urban corridor at night lined with cyan and magenta neon signs reflecting off wet dark concrete. 0s–2.5s: steady determined stride forward, shoulders relaxed, gaze locked ahead. 2.5s–5s: slight chin lift and subtle confident half-smirk as they pass through a shaft of magenta light. Shallow depth of field, subtle film grain, consistent wet reflections.
overall_soundscape: Crisp rhythmic footsteps on wet concrete, distant city hum, faint neon transformer buzz.
non_diegetic_music: Deep pulsing synth bass hit with subtle cinematic momentum.

shots.title: 85mm Dramatic Portrait Push-In
shots.whatItDoes: Slow 85mm close-up push-in as your character turns from profile to lock eyes with the lens.
shots.whyItWorks: 85mm shallow DOF + dark studio void eliminates background drift and gives maximum facial fidelity on any character.
shots.template:
Intimate 85mm close-up shot with a slow, steady 10% push-in on a locked gimbal. Subject 1 ({{CHARACTER}}), keeping their exact RefMod face, hair, and clothing, stands centered against a dark charcoal studio backdrop with a warm 3200K golden rim light outlining their silhouette and soft key light from camera-left. 0s–1.8s: begins in three-quarter profile looking off camera-right, calm and unreadable. 1.8s–3.5s: smoothly turns head and shoulders toward the lens, eyes locking directly into camera. 3.5s–5s: holds an intense, focused gaze with a subtle breath inhale and micro-expression shift. Crisp skin texture, natural eyelashes, shallow bokeh.
overall_soundscape: Quiet studio room tone, soft subtle breath inhale.
non_diegetic_music: Low sustained cello drone swelling gently.

shots.title: Rainy Café Window Monologue
shots.whatItDoes: Warm 50mm medium shot at a rainy café window; character sips espresso and speaks a timestamped line.
shots.whyItWorks: Seated anchor + prop (espresso cup) + timestamped Dialogue window produces rock-solid lip-sync and grounded hand motion.
shots.template:
Warm 50mm medium shot on a locked tripod inside a cozy wooden café beside a rain-streaked glass window showing soft bokeh city lights outside. Subject 1 ({{CHARACTER}}), keeping their exact RefMod face, hair, and clothing, sits at a small round walnut table with a white ceramic espresso cup. Warm tungsten pendant key light from above, cool rainy window fill from camera-right. 0s–1.5s: gazes thoughtfully out the wet glass while lifting the espresso cup for a small sip. 1.5s–6.5s: sets the cup gently on the saucer, turns toward camera-left, and speaks with natural brow movement and relaxed hand gesture. Dialogue (1.8s–5.8s): Subject 1 ({{CHARACTER}}) says warmly, "Sometimes the quietest moments are the ones that change everything."
RefMod usage: visible={{CHARACTER}}; speaking={{CHARACTER}}.
overall_soundscape: Gentle rain pattering on glass, soft porcelain clink on saucer, muted café ambience.
non_diegetic_music: Soft warm acoustic piano chord progression.

shots.title: Studio Desk / Podcast Confessional
shots.whatItDoes: Clean locked 50mm studio desk shot with boom mic; character leans in and speaks straight to camera.
shots.whyItWorks: Locked tripod + consistent studio lighting + boom mic foreground depth makes talking-head clips look identical for every character.
shots.template:
Locked tripod 50mm medium close-up in a sleek dark podcast studio with charcoal acoustic wall panels and a warm amber LED accent strip behind the desk. A matte black broadcast microphone on a boom arm enters cleanly from lower-left foreground. Subject 1 ({{CHARACTER}}), keeping their exact RefMod face, hair, and clothing, sits squarely behind the dark oak desk facing the lens. 0s–1s: leans slightly forward with engaged posture and bright eye contact. 1s–6.5s: speaks directly into camera with natural, expressive hand gestures and confident head nods. Dialogue (1.0s–6.2s): Subject 1 ({{CHARACTER}}) says clearly, "Here is the one thing nobody tells you until it is already too late."
RefMod usage: visible={{CHARACTER}}; speaking={{CHARACTER}}.
overall_soundscape: Crisp close-mic studio voice, subtle chair creak, dead-quiet studio room tone.
non_diegetic_music: None.

shots.title: Over-the-Shoulder Desk Confrontation
shots.whatItDoes: Classic 50mm OTS two-shot across a dimly lit study desk with a glowing monitor and tense dialogue.
shots.whyItWorks: Explicit screen-left/screen-right staging + locked glowing monitor ON prevents character identity bleed in 2-RefMod shots.
shots.template:
Dramatic 50mm over-the-shoulder two-shot in a warm dimly lit study with dark wood bookshelves, a glowing emerald-green banker's lamp, and a desktop monitor on the desk corner that stays brightly lit and ON showing blue documents. Subject 1 ({{CHARACTER}}) sits screen-right facing screen-left, leaning forward tensely across the oak desk; Subject 2 ({{CHARACTER_2}}) is framed over-the-shoulder on screen-left, gripping a ceramic mug. Both keep their exact RefMod faces, hair, and clothing. Slow, subtle push-in. 0s–3.5s: Subject 1 narrows eyes and speaks urgently. 3.5s–6.5s: Subject 2 shifts slightly and responds coolly. Dialogue (0.8s–3.4s): Subject 1 ({{CHARACTER}}) says firmly, "We move tonight or we lose everything." Dialogue (3.8s–6.2s): Subject 2 ({{CHARACTER_2}}) replies calmly, "Then make sure you don't miss."
RefMod usage: visible={{CHARACTER}},{{CHARACTER_2}}; speaking={{CHARACTER}},{{CHARACTER_2}}.
overall_soundscape: Quiet study room tone, soft mug tap on wood, tense breathing.
non_diegetic_music: Subtle low suspense pulse.

shots.title: Deadpan Reaction Slow Zoom (Comedy)
shots.whatItDoes: Bright sitcom-style 50mm shot that smoothly zooms onto your character's deadpan blink and eye-roll.
shots.whyItWorks: Three-beat comedy rhythm (stillness → double-blink → slow deadpan zoom) hits reliably without grotesque exaggeration.
shots.template:
Clean bright 50mm sitcom-style medium shot in a tidy sunlit modern living room with soft beige walls, a framed plant print, and even daylight fill. Subject 1 ({{CHARACTER}}), keeping their exact RefMod face, hair, and clothing, stands centered facing slightly off-camera left. 0s–1.4s: stares off-screen in frozen disbelief with completely still shoulders. 1.4s–2.6s: slowly turns head straight into the camera lens with a completely flat, unimpressed deadpan expression. 2.6s–5s: camera performs a crisp, smooth comedic zoom-in onto their face as they give one slow blink and subtle micro-sigh. Clean exposure, sharp focus, zero motion blur.
overall_soundscape: Quiet bright room tone, faint deadpan exhale.
non_diegetic_music: None.

shots.title: Phone Screen → Shocked Realization
shots.whatItDoes: Nighttime close-up lit by a bright smartphone screen as your character reads a message and freezes in shock.
shots.whyItWorks: Motivated screen under-lighting + clear 3-beat gaze shift (down → freeze → snap up) works consistently for every character.
shots.template:
Moody 65mm medium close-up at night inside a dimly lit bedroom with deep blue-grey shadows. Subject 1 ({{CHARACTER}}), keeping their exact RefMod face, hair, and clothing, holds a smartphone at chest height whose bright cool white-blue screen stays steadily ON and illuminates their face from below. Camera holds steady with subtle handheld micro-breathing. 0s–1.8s: looks down scrolling casually with relaxed brows. 1.8s–3.2s: thumb stops abruptly, eyes widen sharply as they read something shocking, jaw slightly parting. 3.2s–5s: slowly lowers the phone an inch and snaps eyes up toward the dark doorway off-camera.
overall_soundscape: Crisp single smartphone notification chime at 1.5s, sudden quiet room tone, sharp breath intake.
non_diegetic_music: Subtle high-tension synth sting at 2.0s.

shots.title: Doorway Silhouette → Key Light Reveal
shots.whatItDoes: Locked 35mm dark hallway shot; door swings open, golden backlight floods in, and your character steps forward.
shots.whyItWorks: Locked tripod + bright doorway frame acts as a natural stage; stepping from silhouette into key light reveals the character cleanly.
shots.template:
Wide 35mm locked-tripod shot looking straight down a dim wooden hallway toward a closed heavy paneled door centered in frame. Floating dust motes catch faint ambient light. 0s–1.5s: the brass doorknob turns and the door swings inward smoothly, flooding the dark floor with warm golden afternoon sunlight from outside. 1.5s–3.5s: Subject 1 ({{CHARACTER}}), keeping their exact RefMod face, hair, and clothing, steps cleanly across the threshold from silhouette into warm side key light. 3.5s–5s: pauses just inside the hallway, scans the room calmly, and closes the door halfway behind them.
overall_soundscape: Metallic latch click, heavy wooden door creak swinging open, two firm footsteps on hardwood.
non_diegetic_music: Low dramatic brass swell.

shots.title: Night Car Cruise (Sweeping Streetlights)
shots.whatItDoes: 50mm passenger-seat interior shot at night with amber & cyan streetlights rhythmically sweeping across your character.
shots.whyItWorks: Car cabin locks the subject in frame while rhythmic moving light streaks create instant cinematic motion with zero warping.
shots.template:
Moody 50mm interior car shot filmed from the front passenger seat looking at Subject 1 ({{CHARACTER}}) in the driver's seat at night. Subject 1 ({{CHARACTER}}), keeping their exact RefMod face, hair, and clothing, grips the steering wheel calmly while driving through a city at midnight. Warm amber and cool cyan streetlights glide rhythmically across the windshield and across their face, with soft glowing dashboard instruments below. 0s–2.5s: eyes fixed steadily on the road ahead, subtle road vibration. 2.5s–5s: brief thoughtful glance toward the side mirror, subtle exhale, hands adjusting smoothly on the wheel.
overall_soundscape: Low steady engine purr, soft tire hum on asphalt, faint turn-signal click.
non_diegetic_music: Dreamy nocturnal synthwave pad.

shots.title: Golden Hour Rooftop 180° Hero Orbit
shots.whatItDoes: Sweeping 35mm smooth arc around your character on a high-rise rooftop overlooking a sunset city skyline.
shots.whyItWorks: Single smooth semicircular orbit + golden sunset rim light creates a blockbuster trailer shot that flatters every RefMod.
shots.template:
Sweeping 35mm gimbal orbit moving smoothly clockwise in a gentle arc around Subject 1 ({{CHARACTER}}), standing near the concrete ledge of a high-rise city rooftop overlooking a vast glowing golden-hour skyline. Subject 1 ({{CHARACTER}}), keeping their exact RefMod face, hair, and clothing, stands tall with hands relaxed at their sides as a steady evening breeze moves their hair and jacket hem. Warm 3200K low sunset flares softly past their shoulder with rich amber sky and deep violet city shadows below. 0s–2.5s: gazes out over the skyline in quiet determination. 2.5s–5s: as the camera completes its arc to a front three-quarter angle, their expression settles into calm resolve.
overall_soundscape: Steady rooftop wind breeze, distant muffled city traffic far below.
non_diegetic_music: Sweeping emotional orchestral strings rising gently.

shots.title: Parking Garage Chase Sprint (Action)
shots.whatItDoes: Urgent handheld 35mm tracking ahead of your character sprinting down a concrete garage and glancing back.
shots.whyItWorks: Repetitive concrete pillars and overhead fluorescent tubes give strong optical-flow speed cues without losing facial identity.
shots.template:
Urgent handheld 35mm backward tracking shot racing ahead of Subject 1 ({{CHARACTER}}) as they sprint full-speed toward camera down a gritty concrete underground parking garage lined with numbered pillars and cool overhead fluorescent strip lights. Subject 1 ({{CHARACTER}}), keeping their exact RefMod face, hair, and clothing, pumps arms hard with athletic urgency. 0s–2s: full sprint straight forward past parked cars, natural handheld camera bounce. 2s–3.5s: quick panicked glance back over their right shoulder without breaking stride. 3.5s–5s: snaps gaze forward and accelerates toward a glowing green exit sign.
overall_soundscape: Rapid echoing sneakers slapping concrete, heavy breathless panting, distant echoing footsteps behind.
non_diegetic_music: Fast driving action percussion pulse.

shots.title: Crisp 3-Beat Punch Impact (Fight)
shots.whatItDoes: 35mm side-angle 3-beat combat move: grounded wind-up, explosive strike with camera jolt & dust, crisp follow-through.
shots.whyItWorks: Explicit wind-up → impact → follow-through beats with camera jolt eliminate rubbery slow-motion in action clips.
shots.template:
Crisp 35mm side-angle action shot inside a sunlit dusty brick warehouse with diagonal shafts of daylight cutting through floating dust. Subject 1 ({{CHARACTER}}), keeping their exact RefMod face, hair, and clothing, stands in a grounded combat stance screen-left facing a heavy leather punching bag suspended screen-right. 0s–1.4s: plants back foot firmly, drops shoulder, and coils hips in a tight athletic wind-up. 1.4s–2.2s: explodes forward with a snappy right cross that slams squarely into the leather bag with real weight, sending a puff of chalk dust flying and triggering a crisp 2-frame camera jolt. 2.2s–5s: camera stabilizes immediately as the heavy bag swings back on its rattling chain and Subject 1 resets cleanly into guard stance, exhaling sharply.
overall_soundscape: Shoe pivot squeak on concrete, sharp explosive leather impact thud, rattling iron chain, crisp fighter exhale.
non_diegetic_music: Hard percussive impact hit at 1.6s.

shots.title: Sunlit Morning Coffee Pour (Slice of Life)
shots.whatItDoes: Warm 35mm sunlit kitchen shot as your character pours steaming coffee at a wooden island and smiles.
shots.whyItWorks: Natural morning sunbeams + simple everyday prop interaction (pouring coffee) yields ultra-natural physics and warmth.
shots.template:
Warm sunlit 35mm medium-wide shot on a gentle slow dolly-right inside a bright cozy kitchen with pale oak cabinets, potted herbs on the windowsill, and golden morning sunbeams streaming across a wooden island counter. Subject 1 ({{CHARACTER}}), keeping their exact RefMod face, hair, and clothing, stands behind the island. 0s–2.5s: smoothly tilts a glass carafe to pour steaming dark coffee into a speckled ceramic mug, wispy steam curling through the sunbeams. 2.5s–5s: sets the carafe down, lifts the warm mug with both hands, inhales the aroma, and relaxes into a content morning smile.
overall_soundscape: Crisp liquid pouring into ceramic mug, gentle glass set-down on wood, soft morning birdsong outside window.
non_diegetic_music: Light cheerful acoustic guitar fingerpicking.

shots.title: Bathroom Mirror Pep Talk (Reflection)
shots.whatItDoes: Intimate 50mm over-the-shoulder shot into a lightly steamed bathroom mirror as your character regains resolve.
shots.whyItWorks: Mirror framing anchors eye-line and face cleanly in the center while the foreground shoulder adds cinematic depth.
shots.template:
Intimate 50mm over-the-shoulder shot framed past the dark silhouette of Subject 1 ({{CHARACTER}})'s shoulder directly into a lightly steamed tiled bathroom mirror lit by a warm vanity bulb above. In the clear center of the mirror reflection, Subject 1 ({{CHARACTER}}), keeping their exact RefMod face, hair, and clothing, grips both edges of the porcelain sink. 0s–1.8s: head bowed slightly, eyes closed, taking a slow steadying breath. 1.8s–3.5s: raises chin to lock eyes with their own reflection in the mirror, jaw setting firmly. 3.5s–5s: gives one small determined nod and straightens posture.
overall_soundscape: Quiet tiled bathroom acoustics, slow deep exhale, faint single water drip in sink.
non_diegetic_music: Minimalist sparse piano note holding softly.

shots.title: Dark Basement Flashlight Turn (Suspense)
shots.whatItDoes: Handheld 35mm dark basement shot; character sweeps a flashlight beam, hears a creak, and whips around.
shots.whyItWorks: Single volumetric flashlight beam + dusty darkness creates high-contrast chiaroscuro that Singularity v2 renders crisply.
shots.template:
Tense handheld 35mm medium shot inside a pitch-dark concrete basement with old wooden shelves and floating dust particles. Subject 1 ({{CHARACTER}}), keeping their exact RefMod face, hair, and clothing, holds a bright narrow tactical flashlight near their shoulder, the beam cutting sharply through the darkness and casting dramatic bounce light across their face. 0s–2.2s: slowly sweeps the flashlight beam from camera-left to camera-right, eyes scanning nervously with shallow breaths. 2.2s–3.0s: freezes abruptly at a sudden off-screen creak behind them. 3.0s–5s: whips head and flashlight beam sharply over their left shoulder into the deep shadows behind them, expression wide-eyed and tense.
overall_soundscape: Tense quiet basement room tone, soft nervous footsteps, sudden sharp wooden stair creak at 2.2s, quick gasp.
non_diegetic_music: Low eerie sub-bass rumble building quietly.

shots.title: Walk-and-Talk Street Vlog (9:16 Ready)
shots.whatItDoes: Natural 28mm selfie-style walk down a sunlit city sidewalk; character gestures casually while talking to camera.
shots.whyItWorks: 28mm arm's-length perspective + sunlit outdoor daylight + timestamped Dialogue nails authentic Shorts/Reels/TikTok vlogs.
shots.template:
Natural daylight 28mm handheld arm's-length vlog shot tracking smoothly with Subject 1 ({{CHARACTER}}) walking down a bright tree-lined city sidewalk with soft-focus cafes and pedestrians passing behind. Subject 1 ({{CHARACTER}}), keeping their exact RefMod face, hair, and clothing, holds eye contact warmly with the camera while walking at an easy pace. Dappled afternoon sunlight filters through green leaves. 0s–1.2s: smiles brightly and gives a casual wave. 1.2s–6.5s: speaks animatedly with natural conversational hand gestures and expressive eyebrows. Dialogue (1.0s–6.2s): Subject 1 ({{CHARACTER}}) says enthusiastically, "Okay, you are not going to believe what just happened five minutes ago."
RefMod usage: visible={{CHARACTER}}; speaking={{CHARACTER}}.
overall_soundscape: Crisp outdoor voice, light footsteps on pavement, gentle city breeze and distant street ambience.
non_diegetic_music: None.

shots.title: Rainy Night Bus Stop (Melancholy)
shots.whatItDoes: Locked 50mm night shot under a glowing glass bus shelter in pouring rain; character glances down the empty road.
shots.whyItWorks: Backlit rain streaks + cool overhead shelter light create atmospheric cinema with zero camera drift.
shots.template:
Locked tripod 50mm medium shot at night looking into a glass-walled city bus stop shelter illuminated by a cool overhead fluorescent tube while steady rain pours down outside and streaks the glass. Subject 1 ({{CHARACTER}}), keeping their exact RefMod face, hair, and clothing, stands slightly off-center beneath the shelter, shoulders hunched gently against the chill. Wet asphalt behind reflects red and white distant headlights. 0s–2.5s: gazes quietly down the rain-drenched street off camera-left. 2.5s–5s: pulls collar slightly higher, exhales a faint visible mist in the cool night air, and blinks slowly as distant headlights sweep past.
overall_soundscape: Steady heavy rain pattering on shelter roof and glass, distant wet tire swoosh passing by.
non_diegetic_music: Soft melancholic solo piano note.

shots.title: Executive Chair Spin Villain Reveal
shots.whatItDoes: Slow 50mm push-in on a dark office leather chair that swivels 180° to reveal your character with a smirk.
shots.whyItWorks: Classic mechanical reveal (chair rotation) gives a clear, repeatable motion arc that lands squarely on the character's face.
shots.template:
Cinematic 50mm slow push-in inside a dark executive office with tall shadowed blinds and a single crisp overhead spotlight pooling onto a tall black leather swivel chair centered behind a polished desk. 0s–1.2s: the high-back chair faces away toward the dark skyline window, completely hiding the occupant. 1.2s–3.2s: the leather chair swivels smoothly 180 degrees clockwise toward camera, revealing Subject 1 ({{CHARACTER}}), keeping their exact RefMod face, hair, and clothing, seated calmly under the dramatic overhead key light. 3.2s–5s: Subject 1 steeples their fingertips together and curls one corner of their mouth into a slow, knowing smirk.
overall_soundscape: Quiet dark office tone, smooth leather chair swivel creak.
non_diegetic_music: Deep ominous brass chord swelling on the reveal.

shots.title: Victory Fist-Pump & Celebration
shots.whatItDoes: Bright energetic 35mm medium shot; your character pumps both fists in the air, laughs out loud, and celebrates.
shots.whyItWorks: High-energy symmetrical arm motion + clean bright lighting produces joyous, readable expressions without face distortion.
shots.template:
Bright energetic 35mm medium shot on a steady tripod inside a sunlit modern loft with warm wood accents and clean natural daylight. Subject 1 ({{CHARACTER}}), keeping their exact RefMod face, hair, and clothing, stands centered in frame. 0s–1.2s: eyes light up wide with sudden delighted disbelief, breaking into a huge genuine grin. 1.2s–3.2s: throws both fists up into the air in an exuberant double fist-pump, bouncing lightly on their heels and laughing out loud. 3.2s–5s: drops shoulders into a happy breathy chuckle and points triumphantly toward camera.
overall_soundscape: Bright joyful laugh, crisp fabric whoosh from raised arms, light playful foot bounce.
non_diegetic_music: Upbeat feel-good indie synth chime.

shots.title: Change Background → Cyberpunk Tokyo
shots.whatItDoes: Stylize background swap: keeps your video's exact performer & motion, swaps the room to neon Tokyo rain.
shots.whyItWorks: Explicitly locks `<Video 1>` performer + motion while instructing matching cyan/magenta rim-light wrap so the composite looks filmed on location.
shots.template: A rain-drenched cyberpunk Tokyo alleyway at midnight with glowing cyan and magenta neon kanji signs, wet asphalt puddles reflecting neon light, drifting steam from a street-side ramen vent, and matching cyan-magenta rim light wrapping naturally around the performer's shoulders, hair, and grounded floor shadows.
